name: XProtect and security data updates installed automatically
description: Protection against malware. XProtect is macOS's built-in malware protection; its signatures only help while they are current (Richtlinie zum sicheren IT-Betrieb: Virenschutz, operative Threat Intelligence).
query: SELECT value FROM plist WHERE path = '/Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate.plist' AND key = 'ConfigDataInstall';
